selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: original /tmp and /dev/shm mount state before hardening
selected_evidence.summary: findmnt showed /tmp was not a separate mount (rootfs) and /dev/shm lacked noexec; fstab had no prior /tmp or /dev/shm entries

selected_evidence.requirement: fstab modified with persistent noexec,nosuid,nodev options for /tmp and /dev/shm
selected_evidence.summary: Backed up fstab and appended tmpfs entries for /tmp and /dev/shm with defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev

selected_evidence.requirement: Options applied live and mounts show noexec,nosuid,nodev
selected_evidence.summary: mount -o remount /dev/shm and mount /tmp succeeded; findmnt confirms rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec on both

selected_evidence.requirement: Execution and device-node access are actually blocked (falsification proof)
selected_evidence.summary: Chmod+x script on /tmp failed to execute (permission denied, exit 126); mknod succeeded but dd read of the device node failed with permission denied, proving nodev is enforced

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline with boot identity
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 901ef286-c79c-44c0-ad2c-cfde1f6daa7a, uptime since 11:12:18, and healthy /tmp and /dev/shm mount options plus fstab entries
Backgrounded delayed reboot command returned 'reboot scheduled' immediately, before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart in progress / node unreachable during reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Subsequent polls returned connection timeout then connection reset, consistent with the node rebooting

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving a genuine restart occurred
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 901ef286-c79c-44c0-ad2c-cfde1f6daa7a to cfe6cf8b-d967-46f6-81f1-d7f1801dc73a with new uptime since 11:13:02

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: mount options persisted and enforcement still active
selected_evidence.summary: findmnt shows /tmp and /dev/shm still have nosuid,nodev,noexec after reboot; re-ran exec and device-node tests, both blocked, confirming settings survived reboot via fstab
